info.title: PPT Agent API
info.description: Host-independent API for durable PPT Agent runs. Bearer credentials are tenant-bound; user and administrator credentials are distinct, and host identity headers are canonicalized by the service.

get.description: Tenant-scoped, administrator-only aggregation of redacted planning failures.
Tenant-scoped administrator report with filtered Runs, SLA watchdog findings, reconciliation queue, and service metrics.
Tenant-scoped administrator setting used as the authoritative automatic revision limit for newly created Runs after it has been configured.

patch.description: Updates the tenant policy for future Runs only. Once configured, it takes precedence over maxRevisionRounds supplied by callers; existing Runs retain their persisted limit.

post.description: Idempotently reinspects or manually reconciles one Step with an administrator audit event. REINSPECT on a rejected finalize_usage_v2 Step resubmits only the persisted finalize:<runId> identity; it does not resubmit Provider media or create a new accounting identity.

get.description: Returns the authenticated tenant's public V4 feature surface. It lists model identifiers and protocol guarantees, never gateway URLs, credentials, prompts, or Provider-private configuration.

post.description: Creates one isolated V4 quick-deck experiment from controlled text. The evaluator Bearer credential determines the tenant; X-PPT-Agent-Tenant is rejected. Idempotency-Key is intentionally not used: a timeout retry creates a new experiment. The raw JSON body is limited to 1 MiB. This resource never creates a V1 Run or Usage, budget, review, revision, or recovery record.

get.description: Returns the evaluator-tenant-scoped state, actual pixel dimensions, ratio result, selected models, duration, and completed artifact digests. It never exposes prompts, source text, internal blueprint fields, artifact identifiers, or Provider configuration.

Replays bounded, durable quick-deck events after the cursor and then polls live state. Each SSE data field is a QuickDeckEvaluationEvent. The stream closes at evaluation.failed, packaging.completed, or evaluation.expired; reconnect with Last-Event-ID or after and ignore already-applied sequence values.

200.description: Persistent replay followed by live polling; closes at the quick-deck terminal event

get.description: Streams a completed evaluator-owned PPTX or preview. The server verifies immutable artifact metadata before opening the body. EXPIRED content is gone from the public contract; Range requests are rejected.

post.description: Creates a Run for the authenticated tenant and user. Explicit role or project fields in the body must match the authenticated context; the persisted host context is always taken from authentication.

get.description: Returns owner-scoped Runs using a stable updatedAt/id keyset cursor. A cursor remains usable even if its source row is no longer present.

200.description: Run snapshot, approved public artifacts, and a user-facing generation plan when V4 planning is complete

get.description: Returns the compiled user-facing V4 generation plan when it is ready. Non-V4 and not-yet-compiled Runs return an explicit NOT_READY state rather than Provider prompts or internal planning artifacts.
Returns source and image-asset metadata plus page reference IDs after a Blueprint is ready. Raw source text, OCR text, attachment bytes, and internal prompts are never returned.

Replays durable AgentEvent objects after the supplied cursor in batches of at most 100 events and 256 KiB, then shares one live poller per Run. Each SSE data field is the same AgentEvent structure returned by event history. The stream closes after run.completed, run.cancelled, a run.failed event with FINAL or absent terminal accounting, or the later run.accounting.finalized event. A run.failed event with RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED does not close the stream. Clients reconnect with Last-Event-ID or after and must ignore sequences they have already applied.

200.description: Bounded persistent replay followed by shared live polling; closes at the Run terminal event

get.description: Returns durable Run events after the supplied cursor as a JSON page bounded to at most 100 events and 256 KiB. Clients follow pagination.nextAfter while pagination.hasMore is true before opening the live SSE stream.

Returns content only when the owned Run detail reports deliveryAvailability.state AVAILABLE for this exact VERIFIED FINAL Delivery. COMPLETED alone is insufficient; quality recovery, pending accounting, missing verification, and integrity failures return a versioned structured error.

200.description: Integrity-checked owned PNG preview, image-based PPTX, or JSON asset source manifest

409.description: Delivery is not consumable. error.code is DELIVERY_NOT_AVAILABLE and error.details.reason is a DeliveryUnavailableReason.

bearerAuth.description: Tenant-bound service credential. User credentials cannot request administrator role; administrator endpoints require the tenant's distinct administrator credential.

quickDeckEvaluatorAuth.description: Dedicated evaluator credential used only by isolated quick-deck resources.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A key already bound to a different request returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT with retryable=false and action=MODIFY_REQUEST; clients must not retry the conflicting request unchanged.

ContractLink.description: Versioned contract discovery link with rel=service-desc.

RequestId.description: Validated caller request id or a server-generated request id.

RateLimited.description: The authenticated tenant/user write quota is exhausted for the current fixed window.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds until the principal can retry.

AgentEvent.description: Forward-compatible durable event contract. Every runtime-known type uses an explicit typed variant; consumers must ignore unhandled future type values and use sequence for ordering and deduplication.

role.description: Derived from the authenticated service credential. Supplying this field in a create body cannot grant a different role.

pages.description: Ordered, teacher-approved pages. pageNumber must be continuous from 1. Presentation Job V2 retains its separate two-page minimum.

BlueprintSourceAsset.description: Persisted source lineage metadata. Raw image bytes are intentionally excluded. Slides and editable IMAGE/TEXT elements reference these records through sourceAssetIds; IMAGE elements use REUSE_ORIGINAL, REFERENCE_GENERATION, SEARCH_WEB, or REGENERATE.

maxRevisionRounds.description: Legacy per-Run value. It is used only until the tenant administrator configures the revision-round policy; the configured tenant policy takes precedence for future Runs.

slideCount.description: One slide is accepted only when the target Run is VISUAL_DECK_V4.

qualityDisposition.description: Final quality provenance. PENDING and REVIEW_PASSED require qualityOverride false and null quality audits. PENDING remains in force until both page and deck review finish; REVIEW_PASSED means no open findings; SYSTEM_POLICY_ACCEPTED means only explicit non-blocking findings were accepted by system policy; ADMIN_OVERRIDE identifies a real administrator action; HARD_FAILURE identifies a blocking failure and is required whenever status is FAILED.

qualityPolicyAudit.description: System-policy provenance for a completed two-level review. Never contains an administrator actor.

qualityOverrideAudit.description: Real human override provenance. V4 FINAL delivery requires actorRole ADMIN.

error.description: Stable machine-readable interruption or terminal failure. It is null for normally progressing and completed Runs.

progress.description: Materialized latest progress for steps that have not completed or failed.

deliveryId.description: Must equal the id of the single DeliveryRecord in RunDetail.deliveries.

DeliveryAvailability.description: The only authoritative signal for exposing generated output. AVAILABLE is emitted only for the current integrity-checked VERIFIED FINAL Delivery of a COMPLETED Run whose accounting is closed.

PublicBlueprintProjection.description: Strongly typed public Blueprint projection. Provider prompts, negative prompts, OCR text, raw source text, and renderer instructions are excluded.

RunDetail.description: Strict public Run detail. AVAILABLE requires status COMPLETED and exactly one readable public DeliveryRecord; that record's runId must equal RunDetail.id, its id must equal deliveryAvailability.deliveryId, and its revisionRound must equal RunDetail.revisionRound. UNAVAILABLE exposes no DeliveryRecord.
